Class BaseSecuritySearchProvider

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.BaseSecuritySearchProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISecuritySearchProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
BivaSecuritySearch, BoursoramaSecuritySearch, ConsorsbankSecuritySearch, EodhdSecuritySearch, EuronextSecuritySearch, NasdaqNordicSecuritySearch, OnvistaSecuritySearch, OpenFigiSecuritySearch, SixSecuritySearch, ViennaSecuritySearch, XetraSecuritySearch, YahooSymbolSearch
public abstract class BaseSecuritySearchProvider extends Object implements ISecuritySearchProvider
Common frame of all provider adapters. It gives every search the same bounds and the same failure reporting, so an adapter only fetches and converts listings:
  • Request budget: each provider owns one token bucket. A request waits at most maxTokenWait for a token and otherwise ends as SecuritySearchStatus.RATE_LIMITED instead of blocking without bound.
  • Timeouts: one shared HTTP client with a connect timeout, and a request timeout on every request.
  • Status mapping: HTTP 429 becomes RATE_LIMITED, 401/403 NOT_ENTITLED, 5xx PROVIDER_ERROR; a timeout TIMEOUT; any other exception, including a response that cannot be parsed, PROVIDER_ERROR.
  • Identity rules: the fetched listings pass through SearchCandidateMatcher.

    • fetchBaseData

      protected SecurityBaseDataDto fetchBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto candidate, Locale locale) throws Exception
      Fetches the master data of a candidate accepted by ISecuritySearchProvider.supportsBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto). An adapter throws a SearchFailureException with SecuritySearchStatus.NO_MATCH when the identity delivered by the detail endpoint contradicts the candidate.
      Parameters:
      candidate - the candidate of this provider
      locale - language of the user
      Returns:
      the master data, or null when the provider delivered none
      Throws:
      Exception - any failure; it is converted into a status by getSecurityBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto, Locale)

    • fetchCandidates

      protected abstract List<SecuritySearchCandidateDto> fetchCandidates(SecuritySearchQuery query) throws Exception
      Asks the provider and converts its answer into candidates. Identity evidence must be set exactly as the provider established it; the conflict check and ordering follow in SearchCandidateMatcher.
      Parameters:
      query - the query, already accepted by ISecuritySearchProvider.supports(SecuritySearchQuery)
      Returns:
      the listings delivered by the provider, possibly empty
      Throws:
      Exception - any failure; it is converted into a status by search(SecuritySearchQuery)

    • send

      protected HttpResponse<String> send(HttpRequest.Builder requestBuilder) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Sends a request within the request budget and the request timeout. Status codes that say nothing about the instrument are turned into a SearchFailureException; every other response, including 4xx codes a provider uses for "not found", is returned to the adapter.
      Parameters:
      requestBuilder - the request without timeout and user agent
      Returns:
      the response with a status code below 500 other than 401, 403 and 429
      Throws:
      IOException - on a transport failure, including HttpTimeoutException
      InterruptedException - when the thread is interrupted while waiting for a token or the response
